listing.name: Hypershroud 2.0
listing.summary: Gives Hyperspace a bold new look, turning it into a deep, hungry crimson by default. If you’re feeling adventurous, you can swap it out for one of several alternate realities: Pink Delirium, Luddic Verdance, Cyan [REDACTED], Violet Warpstorm, and a secret fifth hue you’ll have to discover for yourself. Just move your chosen color set into the main graphics directory to shift the tone of the void.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the hyperspace visual style to a deep crimson by default, with options for alternate color schemes.

description: Replaces the standard hyperspace appearance with a bold crimson theme. Offers several alternative color palettes including Pink Delirium, Luddic Verdance, Cyan [REDACTED], Violet Warpstorm, and a secret fifth hue. Users can switch between these styles by moving the desired color set into the main graphics directory.
